name: Game.GetFormFromFile load index
description: Flags a hex FormID literal passed to Game.GetFormFromFile that carries a non-zero load index, or leading zero digits, neither of which Game.GetFormFromFile ever uses.
definition: Flags, as a `[warning]`, a hex FormID literal passed to a qualified `Game.GetFormFromFile` call (positionally or by name) whose bits go beyond the local FormID range its file name argument's own plugin type actually uses — up to `0xFFFFFF` for a normal plugin, or `0xFFF` for one whose file name literally ends in `.esl` — or that pads the value with leading zero digits beyond what's needed to write it. `Game.GetFormFromFile` always resolves the load index (a normal plugin's master index, or a light plugin's own index among other light plugins) from the file name argument itself at runtime and discards whatever the FormID argument's own high bits say instead, and a leading zero digit never changes a hex literal's value either way, so both serve no use and are easy to mistake for meaningful data. Only flags when both arguments are literals (the FormID argument itself, and a literal file name so the local range being checked is actually known); a runtime expression in either position is left unflagged rather than guessed at. Automatically fixable: the fix rewrites the flagged literal to the local FormID written at minimal hex length (e.g. `0x01012345` becomes `0x12345`).
